## 2024-11-01 - Fix XSS Vulnerability in Generated Plan SVGs
**Vulnerability:** Found multiple instances where SVGs generated for deed plans (`output.svg`) and mutation plans (`svgOutput`) were being rendered using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: ... }}` without any sanitization. This is a severe XSS vector since users supply inputs to these plans (e.g., project names, parcel numbers) that could inject malicious scripts.
**Learning:** Even though SVGs are generated by application logic, they incorporate unescaped user inputs directly into the SVG string in some places, allowing an attacker to break out of text tags and execute arbitrary JavaScript when the SVG is rendered. The project actually has a dedicated sanitization function (`sanitizeHtml` in `@/lib/security/sanitize.ts`) designed specifically to handle SVG inputs and filter out malicious content while retaining allowed standard geometric tags.
**Prevention:** Always wrap dynamically generated SVGs inside `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with `sanitizeHtml(...)`. Even if the output comes from an internal API or generation script, assume the data may contain unsanitized user inputs, especially when text elements are used within the SVG.
